# Five cyclic 512-qubit quaternary PP examples

The retained inputs are the five 512-qubit PP rows in the [public catalogue](../../docs/CATALOGUE.md).
Their coefficient/exponent arrays, physical frames, witnesses and execution
records are linked by each code.json. All reported distances 19–20 are exact;
the supplied frame widths remain upper bounds.

From the folder root, run `python3 verification/small_quaternary_pp/check.py`.
It reconstructs each code and frame, checks every translated canonical pairing,
the physical witness and sector reflection, and audits input/source hashes and
complete root/first-branch coverage. Original interrupted-prefix receipts are
retained where later completed partitions refer to them; they are not credited
as completed exclusions themselves.

To rerun a selected exclusion with a C++17 compiler:

```sh
python3 verification/small_quaternary_pp/check.py --code pp-f4-512-128-19-w10 --replay --seconds 3600
```

A timeout yields no new lower bound. Records under evidence/records/small_pp_records
are preserved with metadata normalized. The quick check validates completed execution
records rather than a formal node-by-node proof. Off-paper campaign examples
and the research search diary are intentionally absent.

Public receipts have calendar, job, and workstation metadata removed. File hashes
bind the normalized copies. Executable fingerprints are declarations; compiled
binaries are omitted. Portable replay builds from the supplied source.
